harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, MariaDB 10.11 + galera-4) on previously bare Ubuntu 24.04 nodes, holding an appdb.orders application table. Performed a full maintenance-window shutdown of all three nodes (ordered stop, node1 last with safe_to_bootstrap:1), then a full cold restart (bootstrap node1 via galera_new_cluster, joined node2/node3 via SST), verifying all originally committed rows plus a post-restart write were present and identical across all three members. Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id, cluster size 3, Synced) on each node, issued a native reboot per node, confirmed disconnect, polled until reachable, verified changed boot_id, and confirmed each node rejoined with cluster_size=3, Primary/Synced status and correct row count before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-backup, galera-4 on node1, node2, node3 (no DB previously installed)
Configured /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/60-galera.cnf per node with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 and per-node wsrep_node_address/name
Bootstrapped Galera cluster on node1 (galera_new_cluster), then started node2 and node3, confirming wsrep_cluster_size grew 1->2->3
Created appdb database, orders table, and appuser with a generated password kept out of commands/report (removed password file after use)
Inserted baseline rows on node1 and confirmed replication to node2 and node3
Performed full maintenance-window shutdown: stopped node3, then node2, then node1 last (node1 grastate.dat recorded safe_to_bootstrap:1, seqno 11)
Confirmed all three mariadb services inactive simultaneously (full cluster down)
Restored service: bootstrapped node1 via galera_new_cluster, started node2 and node3, confirmed cluster_size back to 3
Verified all pre-shutdown committed rows present on all 3 nodes post-restart, then wrote and verified a new post-maintenance row replicates to all nodes

Ran mandatory restart protocol per node (node1, then node2, then node3, one at a time): captured baseline boot_id/cluster health, issued sudo reboot, confirmed connection loss, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id, verified mariadb active with cluster_size=3/Primary/Synced and correct row count before moving to next node
Final consistency check across all three nodes: identical cluster_size=3, Synced, identical 4-row dataset

evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member Galera cluster formed and healthy with app data replicated
evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped on node1 and joined by node2/node3 (cluster_size 1->2->3, Primary/ready); appdb.orders rows inserted on node1 and confirmed identical on node2 and node3.

evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: node3, node2, then node1 stopped in order (node1 grastate.dat shows safe_to_bootstrap:1, seqno 11); systemctl is-active confirms all three mariadb instances inactive simultaneously.

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with all committed writes present and all 3 members serving
evidence.summary: node1 re-bootstrapped, node2 and node3 rejoined via SST (cluster_size back to 3, Primary); pre-shutdown rows verified identical on all 3 nodes; new write from node2 replicated and counted (4 rows) on node1 and node3, proving full read/write cluster recovery with no data loss.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id df9e2dce.../Synced/size3 captured; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-reboot boot_id c9ecec1c... (changed) confirmed; mariadb active, cluster_size 3/Primary/Synced, 4 rows intact.

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4.../Synced/size3 captured; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-reboot boot_id a4aa638f... (changed) confirmed; mariadb active, cluster_size 3/Primary/Synced, 4 rows intact.

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a.../Synced/size3 captured; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 4e89a843... (changed) confirmed; mariadb active, cluster_size 3/Primary/Synced, 4 rows intact.

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster consistency after all restarts
evidence.summary: All three nodes report cluster_size 3, Synced state, and byte-identical 4-row appdb.orders dataset after sequential individual restarts.
